description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%), comparing six different models: Base, FT, IKE, MEND, MEMIT, and ROME. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" with a logarithmic scale, ranging from 0 to 10^3, with tick labels at 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 55, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The Base model is represented by a black solid line with circle markers, starting at around 28% at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and increasing to approximately 32% at 10^3. The FT model is depicted by a blue solid line with triangle markers, starting at around 30% at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and rising to about 39% at 10^3. The IKE model is shown as a red solid line with triangle markers, beginning at around 32% at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and increasing to approximately 42% at 10^3. The MEND model is represented by a brown dashed line with diamond markers, starting at around 37% at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and rising to about 46% at 10^3. The MEMIT model is illustrated by a purple dashed line with square markers, starting at around 36% at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and increasing to approximately 47% at 10^3. The ROME model is depicted by a green solid line with square markers, beginning at around 43% at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and rising to about 58% at 10^3. All lines exhibit an overall increasing trend as the Co-occurrence Number increases.
